items.exampleEn: I watch TV in the evening.
We have a meeting this afternoon.
What do you do on the weekend?
It is a quarter past nine.

items.sentenceEn: The class starts at nine tomorrow.

items.audioEn: The meeting is at a quarter past nine tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 會議在明天九點十五分。

items.sentenceEn: We go to the mountains on the weekend.

items.stemEn: What is the ____ today? It is May 5.
items.stemZh: 今天幾月幾號？今天是五月五日。

items.passageEn: It is winter now, and this weekend is cold. On Saturday afternoon, Jenny goes to a movie with her sister. The movie starts at a quarter past two. In the evening, they eat hot soup at home. Tomorrow is Sunday, and they will visit their aunt.
items.passageZh: 現在是冬天，這個週末很冷。星期六下午，Jenny 和她妹妹去看電影，電影兩點十五分開始。晚上她們在家喝熱湯。明天是星期天，她們要去看阿姨。

rubricZh: 「明天晚上」可寫 tomorrow evening、tomorrow night 等，前面不加 in 或 on
提議可用 Let's 等（例如 Let's meet）

items.instructionZh: 用 weekend 造一個句子，說說你這個週末要做什麼。
referenceEn: I will visit my grandmother this weekend.
This weekend, I am going to the beach.
rubricZh: 「這個週末」用 this weekend，前面不加 on（放句首或句尾都可以）
未來的計畫用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to、現在進行式）
